0022600101.text: The Warriors (0-1, 13th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, 1 game back) host the Grizzlies (1-0, 5th in the West and 2nd in the Southwest) in a matchup where both teams have played one game this season, and Golden State is coming off a road loss. Golden State holds a 3-0 edge in the 2025-26 season series, and its most recent meeting was a 133-112 win in Memphis on February 25, 2026, while the 2026-27 season series has no games yet. Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), and Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), and Brandin Podziemski (back soreness) and Charles Bassey (knee) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Memphis is without Cedric Coward (wrist sprain) and Isaiah Stewart (ankle sprain), who are also day-to-day and game-time decisions.
